title: Master of Business Administration Full Time Programme
institution: UCT Graduate School of Business, University of Cape Town
about: The UCT Graduate School of Business is accepting applications for its one-year, face-to-face full-time MBA in Cape Town, starting 11 August 2027. The listed application period runs from 1 September 2026 to 31 May 2027.

upskill.name: AI Investment, ROI & Business Value
why: field "Business administration" (full-time MBA) -> objective "Build compelling AI business cases and establish measurement approaches that evaluate return on investment beyond the initial deployment stage." (field-level fit; the only stated requirement is an application fee, which no course covers)
